LESSON: DIVORCE

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: General
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.1: Divorce
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Divorce, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 General.

Key inquiry question: Why are conflicts common in marriage? 2. How can Muslims reduce conflicts in marriage?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research on the causes of conflicts in marriage and make notes,

2. discuss the steps of conflict resolution in marriage with illustrations from the Qur’an and Hadith in groups and make a class presentation,

3. dramatise conflict resolution mechanisms in marriage, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play or dramatise. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research on the causes of conflicts in marriage and make notes,
2. discuss the steps of conflict resolution in marriage with illustrations from the Qur’an and Hadith in groups and make a class presentation,
3. dramatise conflict resolution mechanisms in marriage, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play or dramatise. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Divorce together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of interpretation and inference enhanced as learners identify the

causes of conflicts and the steps in conflict resolution in marriage.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of making connections enhanced as learners dramatise conflict resolution

mechanisms in marriage.

• Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learned knowledge enhanced as learners discuss the steps of conflict

resolution in marriage with illustrations from the Qur’an and Hadith in groups, and make class presentations.

Values:
• Peace is enhanced as learners research on the causes of conflicts in marriage and make notes.

• Love is enhanced through discussions on the steps of conflict resolution in marriage.
